policy: Remove only the eight exact retained generic owner envelopes and their source ink/navigation. Complete original records and removed navigation are retained here. Complete source part models are supplied separately; their exact navigation parts replace the removed generic navigation. Every unrelated coloured triangle, source ink segment, navigation record and packet field is preserved. Candidates and merge descriptors only; this script never publishes. Integration must check each current packet against oldSha256 before copying its candidate and merge only the matching chunk descriptors.
